description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git submodule functionalities, specifically handling mixed ref storage formats. It includes setup procedures, configurations, repository initializations, and multiple test cases that verify submodule behavior with different reference formats, cloning, status, and pull operations.

methods.name: test_ref_format
methods.description: Defines a function that writes a reference format to a file and verifies if a Git repository uses the expected ref format.
